data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 627.639m. During 2021 there was a net strengthening in gross claims estimates driven by development on the 2019 underwriting year (gross adverse movement of approximately GBP 33.5m as derived from the gross claims development table). The syndicate also experienced major balance sheet movements due to the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transfer of the 2018 year to Syndicate 3500 which reduced gross claims outstanding by c. GBP 414.7m. The claims incurred note records a small net favourable prior year development of GBP 2.343m (net of reinsurance), indicating mixed movements by line. Catastrophe activity in 2021 (notably Hurricane Ida and European floods) increased current year catastrophe losses but the prior-year reserve change calculated from the gross triangle is an adverse movement concentrated in 2019.

Catastrophe losses during the year exceeded long term average expectations in 2021, with notable events including Hurricane Ida and European floods.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) gross figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (2019 column). The claims incurred note quotes a net prior-year favourable development of GBP 2.343m which conflicts in sign/magnitude with the gross PYD derived for 2019; RITC of the 2018 year (transfer to Syndicate 3500) materially altered gross claims outstanding and can distort simple year-on-year comparisons. Lob movements above are taken from the claims incurred note but those amounts are stated 'net of reinsurance' in the report; gross per-LOB PYD gross detail is not separately provided. 'Miscellaneous' was mapped to 'Aggregate' for standard LOB reporting purposes. Use caution: gross triangle only contains 2019, 2020, 2021 columns - only 2019 was eligible for PYD calculation by the guidance (exclude 2020 and 2021).
